```{python}
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown, display

summary_file = Path(summary_file)
coverage_file = Path(coverage_file)
blast_file = Path(blast_file)

summary = pd.read_csv(
    summary_file,
    sep="\t",
    keep_default_na=False,
)

coverage = pd.read_csv(
    coverage_file,
    sep="\t",
    keep_default_na=False,
)

blast = pd.read_csv(
    blast_file,
    keep_default_na=False,
)

if summary.empty:
    raise ValueError(f"Summary table is empty: {summary_file}")

row = summary.iloc[0]
```

## Sample

```{python}
display(Markdown(f"### `{sample_id}`"))
```

## Analytical overview

```{python}
review_flags = str(row["review_flags"])

if review_flags == "NONE":
    review_text = "No review flags were generated."
else:
    review_text = review_flags.replace(";", ", ")

overview = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Metric": [
            "Segments detected",
            "Segments passing coverage",
            "Consensus segments",
            "H5N1 screen",
            "GenoFLU status",
            "Review flags",
        ],
        "Value": [
            row["segments_detected"],
            row["segments_pass"],
            row["consensus_segments"],
            row["h5n1_screen"],
            row["genoflu_status"],
            review_text,
        ],
    }
)

display(HTML(overview.to_html(index=False, escape=False)))
```

## Read processing

```{python}
read_metrics = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Metric": [
            "Reads before filtering",
            "Reads after filtering",
            "Reads removed",
            "Bases before filtering",
            "Bases after filtering",
            "Q20 rate before",
            "Q20 rate after",
            "Q30 rate before",
            "Q30 rate after",
            "Reads with adapters",
        ],
        "Value": [
            row["reads_before"],
            row["reads_after"],
            int(row["reads_before"]) - int(row["reads_after"]),
            row["bases_before"],
            row["bases_after"],
            f'{float(row["q20_rate_before"]) * 100:.1f}%',
            f'{float(row["q20_rate_after"]) * 100:.1f}%',
            f'{float(row["q30_rate_before"]) * 100:.1f}%',
            f'{float(row["q30_rate_after"]) * 100:.1f}%',
            row["reads_with_adapters"],
        ],
    }
)

display(HTML(read_metrics.to_html(index=False)))
```

## Segment coverage

```{python}
coverage_display = coverage[
    [
        "segment",
        "contig",
        "length",
        "median_depth",
        "mean_depth",
        "breadth_covered",
        "coverage_flag",
    ]
].copy()

coverage_display.columns = [
    "Segment",
    "IRMA contig",
    "Length",
    "Median depth",
    "Mean depth",
    "Breadth covered",
    "Status",
]

coverage_display["Breadth covered"] = coverage_display[
    "Breadth covered"
].map(lambda value: f"{float(value) * 100:.1f}%")

display(HTML(coverage_display.to_html(index=False)))
```

```{python}
coverage_plot = coverage.copy()
coverage_plot["status"] = coverage_plot["coverage_flag"]

fig = px.bar(
    coverage_plot,
    x="segment",
    y="median_depth",
    color="status",
    title="Median coverage depth by segment",
    labels={
        "segment": "Segment",
        "median_depth": "Median depth",
        "status": "Coverage status",
    },
)

fig.add_hline(
    y=float(coverage_threshold),
    line_dash="dash",
    annotation_text=f"Coverage threshold: {float(coverage_threshold):g}x",
)

fig.show()
```

## Interpretation

```{python}
interpretation = []

if int(row["segments_pass"]) == 8:
    interpretation.append(
        "All eight influenza A segments passed the configured coverage threshold."
    )
else:
    interpretation.append(
        f'{int(row["segments_pass"])} of 8 influenza A segments passed the '
        "configured coverage threshold."
    )

if row["h5n1_screen"] == "PASS":
    interpretation.append(
        "The sample met the pipeline's IRMA-supported H5N1 screening criterion."
    )
else:
    interpretation.append(
        "The sample did not meet the pipeline's H5N1 screening criterion."
    )

if str(row["failed_segment_names"]) != "NONE":
    failed = str(row["failed_segment_names"]).replace(",", ", ")
    interpretation.append(f"Segments requiring review: {failed}.")

display(Markdown("\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in interpretation)))
```

> **Interpretation note:** The H5N1 result is an IRMA-supported analytical screening flag. It is not an independent confirmatory subtype test and should be interpreted with coverage, controls, sequence quality, and other samples from the sequencing run.
